ref/zero_faces.prompt: Expression sheet for ZERO, the first (leftmost) character in the reference lineup — keep his face, hair with the cowlick, thick eyebrows, mole under the left eye and burnt-orange sweater exactly the same. Plain warm-white background, six head-and-shoulders portraits in a 3x2 grid, all facing slightly toward the viewer: (1) neutral tired, (2) anxiously staring down at a phone screen held in his hand, lit by its glow, (3) deadpan flat stare with half-lidded eyes, (4) startled with wide eyes and a small sweat drop, (5) eyes glistening with held-back tears but a small gentle smile, (6) laughing warmly with eyes curved.

ref/mom_faces.prompt: Expression sheet for MOM, the second character in the reference lineup — keep her face, short tight curly perm with gray roots, smile lines and lavender quilted vest over the floral blouse exactly the same. Plain warm-white background, six head-and-shoulders portraits in a 3x2 grid: (1) warm gentle smile, (2) excited and delighted with raised eyebrows and open-mouth smile, (3) squinting hard at a phone held very close to her eyes, typing with one finger, (4) groggy and half-asleep with heavy eyelids and a dreamy little smile, wearing a light hospital gown, (5) worried with brows knit, (6) playful teasing grin.
